recentItems.title: Tiger Shroff Firing Incident: Sister Krishna Shroff REFUSES to answer questions on actor's health
recentItems.description:
Krishna Shroff was spotted at Mr Faisu and Tanya Siddiqui’s wedding reception in Mumbai amid concerns over brother Tiger Shroff’s safety following the firing incident in Juhu. When paparazzi asked her about the actor’s health, Krishna avoided the questions, repeatedly saying “Thank you” before getting into her car. Meanwhile, Mumbai Police have provided security to Tiger as the investigation into the shooting continues.

recentItems.title: Ranbir Kapoor gets CALLED Ranveer Singh at Ramayana event, Dil Raju REALISES mistake and apologises
recentItems.description:
Ranbir Kapoor was mistakenly called Ranveer Singh by Telugu producer Dil Raju at the Ramayana: Part 1 pre-release event in Hyderabad. Dil Raju realised his mistake, laughed and quickly apologised, creating a light-hearted moment that has gone viral. Meanwhile, Ranbir praised his co-star Yash and spoke about his admiration for the actor's passion for filmmaking.
